s5.1: My {model} is as good as new!
s5.3: Perfect repair, couldn't have asked for more.

s4.3: {shop} is a proper little stall that knows its stuff.

s3.2: The phone works, but it wasn't all smooth sailing.

partial.1: The problem is only half fixed.
partial.2: One thing got fixed, the other stayed just as it was.

not_fixed.1: The fault is exactly where it was before.
not_fixed.2: I got it back just as broken as when I handed it over.

new_broken.1: On the bright side, something that used to work now doesn't.
new_broken.2: It left the bench with a brand-new fault.

pairing.1: After the repair I lost a feature I used to have, and nobody warned me.
pairing.2: Unlocking and the screen colours aren't what they used to be.

screws.1: Shake it and something rattles: there are screws missing.
screws.2: The housing creaks, I reckon a few screws got forgotten.

leftover.1: A piece of my phone was left on the bench. On the bench!
leftover.2: There was a part “left over”. It's not flat-pack furniture.

not_closed.1: I got it back still open.
not_closed.2: The screen wasn't even closed up.

seal_lost.1: I was told it's no longer water resistant: a pity.
seal_lost.2: No new seal, so goodbye waterproofing.

seal_kept.1: A new seal went in too: splash-proof once again.
seal_kept.2: Sealed up by the book, perfect for the boat.

clean.1: I got it back spotless, not a grain of sand.
clean.2: It even got cleaned inside and out. A true gentleman.

cheap_part.1: You can tell the replacement part is a cheap one, though.
cheap_part.2: The new part isn't the same quality as the original, and it shows.

premium_part.1: A refurbished original part was fitted: top quality.
premium_part.2: First-rate parts, you can feel the difference.

fast.1: Super fast, it was ready way ahead of schedule.
fast.2: I hadn't even finished my coconut and it was already done.

late.1: I had to wait longer than promised.
late.2: Punctuality needs work: it wasn't ready at the agreed time.

price_low.1: And at a really honest price.
price_low.2: I spent far less than I feared.

price_fair.2: The bill was right, no surprises.

price_high.1: A bit pricey for what was done.

mistakes.1: I saw quite a bit of fumbling during the job.
mistakes.2: A few too many curses during the teardown.

expert.1: Clearly knows the trade: working from memory, no guide in sight.
expert.2: The hands of a real expert, hypnotic to watch.

misdiagnosis.1: At first I was told the problem was something else.

atmosphere.1: And the place is gorgeous, I'd go back just for the atmosphere.
atmosphere.2: A lovingly kept stall right by the sea.

s3.2: Nothing to rave about, nothing to complain about.

s2.1: I don't think I'll be back.

ripoff.1: I was quoted a crazy amount for my {model}. Daylight robbery!
ripoff.2: Absurd quote: at {shop} they think customers are ATMs.

never_ready.1: My {model} wasn't ready when it should have been. I took it back still broken.
never_ready.2: Broken promises: I came back at the agreed time and the phone was still in pieces.
